Summary of Graduate Degrees Offered
Note: Many of the degrees offered have multiple tracks leading toward their completion. Consult contents of this bulletin related to the various departments and the respective degrees offered for detailed information on these tracks. Texas Southern University does not offer an undergraduate degree in nursing; however, students interested in pursuing this degree elsewhere may earn lower level credits needed for this degree at the University. The Department of Biology administers a pre-nursing program, and students choosing to pursue this course of study should consult that department’s section of this bulletin for more information.
